segments.text:
V. 18.
They all began to make excuſe—One of them pleads only his own Will, I go: Another, a pretended Neceſſity, I muſt •eeds go: The third, Impoſſibility, I cannot come. All of them want the holy Hatred mentioned, ver. 26. All of them periſh by Things in themſelves lawful. I muſt needs go—The moſt urgent worldly Affairs frequently fall out juſt at the Time when GOD makes the freeſt Offers of Salvation.
